violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE NOT WASH HANDS AFTER SWITCHING TASKS FROM PREPARING RAW CHICKEN TO GETTING ICE.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EHS EXPLAINED PROPER HAND WASHING. EMPLOYEE WASHED HANDS, SANITIZED ICE MACHINE DOOR AND REPLACED ICE SCOOP.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The concentration of chlorine in the chemical dish machine was observed at 0ppm.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. PIC FIXED THE DISH MACHINE. FINAL CONCENTRATION WAS 50ppm

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands.
